settings.rejected: The server explicitly rejected this submission. Your draft is retained; check it and review again.
settings.storageError: The previous submission identity cannot be read. An unresolved request cannot be ruled out. Check local storage before proceeding.
settings.loadError: Configuration could not be read. This does not undo a publication. Read it again.
settings.detailsUnavailable: Publication details are unavailable. This does not establish that nothing was committed.
